Women's Hockey Coach Marijne Highlights Need for Field Goal Improvement

Indian women's hockey coach Janneke Marijne has emphasized the need for the team to improve their ability to score field goals. She stated that while there is still much work to be done, scoring from field positions remains a key priority for the team's development and success.
